# Decision Memo: Vendor Selection

**To:** CFO
**From:** Priya, Procurement
**Date:** [Current Date]
**Re:** Year-One Vendor Recommendation

## Summary

Recommending **Vendor Alpha** for year-one engagement.

## Cost Comparison

| Item | Alpha | Beta |
|---|---|---|
| Annual Subscription | $72,000 | $60,000 |
| One-Time Setup | $20,000 | $10,000 |
| **Year-One Total** | **$92,000** | **$70,000** |
| Within $100K Budget | ✅ Yes | ✅ Yes |
| SSO Available | ✅ Yes | ❌ No |

## Evaluation Against Constraints

**Budget:** Both vendors fall within the $100,000 year-one ceiling. Alpha costs $22,000 more but remains $8,000 under budget.

**SSO Requirement:** SSO is mandatory before production. Alpha includes SSO. Beta does not offer SSO and has no committed delivery date, meaning production launch is indefinitely blocked.

**Other Requirements:** Both vendors meet all other stated requirements.

## Risk Assessment

Selecting Beta saves $22,000 but introduces unquantifiable schedule risk. Without SSO, the platform cannot enter production. There is no contractual guarantee Beta will deliver SSO on any timeline. Delays would stall the project, potentially eroding or exceeding the initial savings through lost productivity and extended parallel costs.

## Recommendation

**Select Vendor Alpha at $92,000 year-one total.** It is the only option that satisfies all mandatory requirements within budget. Beta's lower price is irrelevant given it cannot meet the SSO production gate.

Requesting CFO approval to proceed with contract execution.
